tools.name: vox_git_status
tools.description: Get current git working tree status.

tools.name: vox_git_diff
tools.description: Show uncommitted git diff for a file or the whole tree.

tools.name: vox_git_blame
tools.description: Show line-by-line git blame for a file.

tools.name: vox_run_tests
tools.description: Run cargo test for a specific crate, optionally filtered by test name.

tools.name: vox_test_all
tools.description: Run cargo test for the entire workspace.

tools.name: vox_build_crate
tools.description: Run cargo build for a crate or the whole workspace.

tools.name: vox_check_workspace
tools.description: Run cargo check for the entire workspace and return diagnostics.

tools.name: vox_kb_search
tools.description: Search the curated KB Library (Vox docs plus docs/src/library) by BM25 over heading chunks; returns ranked hits.

tools.name: vox_memory_search
tools.description: Hybrid retrieval over memory logs, VoxDb document chunks, and repo inventory.

tools.name: vox_spawn_agent
tools.description: Spawn a new orchestrator agent queue (optional dynamic/transient agent for auto-retire).

tools.name: vox_submit_task
tools.description: Submit a new task to the orchestrator. Routes to the best agent by file affinity.
